QuestionStmt.S: Identify product A in following reaction. $$\mathrm{C_6H_5N_2^+Cl^- \xrightarrow{C_2H_5OH} A + N_2 + CH_3CHO + HCl}$$

Solution.S:
Benzenediazonium chloride (C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻) reacts with ethanol to give benzene (C₆H₆), acetaldehyde, nitrogen gas, and HCl.

$$\mathrm{C_6H_5N_2^+Cl^- + C_2H_5OH \rightarrow C_6H_6 + CH_3CHO + N_2 + HCl}$$

Thus product A is benzene, which corresponds to option A.
